shared_elements: carved upright/columnar block treated as a bearer of imagery
schematic figurative carving in relief-like low modelling
justification: Both are upright columnar blocks bearing schematic figurative carving, and A's arms folded across the body faintly echo the anthropomorphising of a pillar, but the depicted content differs almost entirely: A shows a single large human head and torso with facial features and hands, while B shows stacked registers of animals in profile (long-necked bird, quadrupeds, crouching creatures) separated by a zigzag band and geometric signs. Beyond the generic fact of carved figures on a vertical shaft, there is no shared specific motif, relationship or compositional scheme.
